adopted_retention: D41: disclosed knowledge survives clear, withdrawal and defeat
limits: The learning and evaluation trajectories use existing Z/AB policies. Knowledge is not used to change actions or builds; no human or optimal-policy benefit is measured.
L1-L4 are selected examples, not a frequency or win-rate sample. L1 and L2 arrival withdrawals are dependent counterfactuals.
The evaluation seed differs from all learning seeds. Differences also include build or route for some cases; this is a referenceability check, not a controlled learning-effect estimate.
Played card faces and encounter identities are public trial inputs. Unplayed private cards and hidden abilities are not observations.

Initial catalogues are fixed authored Z profiles: V0/V1 share a weak-card profile, E1 has a core profile. They are not current private decks or a universal rule for unidentified/random loadout variants.
Only newly acquired Z reward channels are observed. Concrete reward items, unknown drop candidates and drop probabilities remain unspecified.
Public passive descriptions, field-material provenance, player-acquired borrowed cards and cards never used as an NPC main card are outside this observation adapter.
D41 is adopted. All three initial-catalogue disclosure policies are comparison candidates; UI, identification presentation and complete product persistence are not implemented.
